name: add_note
description: Save a note for the user. Call this whenever the user shares something they want to remember or asks you to write something down.

text.description: The note content to store, in the user's own words.

name: list_notes
description: List every note the user has saved, oldest first. Takes no arguments.

name: search_notes
description: Find saved notes whose text contains the given query. Use this to answer questions about what the user has previously saved.

query.description: Text to search for within saved notes.
